Even with the prior buff, Rocketeer was still bad for single-target, except for the Level 2 upgrade. The explosion range buff means it can now hit up to 3 enemies at max, which does give it a DPS of 179.61, assuming all 3 enemies get dealt full damage. An explosion radius of 8, which is actually just slightly less than it has in the present day, is still decent for crowd-control, but overall, this rebalance was just really dumb.
